name: autodesk-flow-studio
description: Create images and 3D models from a prompt or a photo with Autodesk® Flow Studio in ChatGPT, and keep refining them in the chat.

interface.longDescription:
Create images and 3D models from a prompt or a photo with Autodesk® Flow Studio in ChatGPT, and keep refining them in the chat.

What you can do:
- Create an image from a text prompt, then edit it by describing the change or generate a new variation.
- Turn a prompt or an image into a draft 3D model and view it in an interactive viewer.
- Refine a model by rebuilding its mesh at the level of detail you need, and retexture it from a prompt or a reference image.
- Download models as GLB, OBJ, STL or 3MF for 3D printing, games, film and design work.
- Browse your Flow Studio library to pick up where you left off on past projects and generations.
- Pick the AI model for each step and save the ones you use most as defaults.

What you need:
- An Autodesk account with a Flow Studio Lite plan or higher.

About Autodesk
The world's designers, engineers, builders, and creators trust Autodesk to help them design and make anything. From the buildings we live and work in, to the cars we drive and the bridges we drive over. From the products we use and rely on, to the movies and games that inspire us. Autodesk's Design and Make Platform unlocks the power of data to accelerate insights and automate processes, empowering our customers with the technology to create the world around us and deliver better outcomes for their business and the planet. For more information, visit autodesk.com.
defaultPrompt: Make a picture of a cozy reading nook by a rainy window, in warm watercolor style.
Create a 3D model of a cartoon robot mascot with round eyes and a teal body.
Show me my recent Flow Studio projects.

positive.description: Text to image. Should check generation access once, then create the image. Chat 1.
positive.prompt: @Flow Studio Make a picture of a friendly white humanoid robot with a smooth glossy shell and soft grey joints, waving hello in a bright, clean studio. Soft daylight, gentle shadows, calm mood, wide shot. Call the project Friendly robots.
positive.expected_behavior: An image card shows progress, then the finished image, with Download and Open in Flow Studio. The project is called Friendly robots.

positive.description: Text to 3D. Should create four draft variants and show the 3D viewer. Chat 2.
positive.prompt: @Flow Studio Make a 3D model of a friendly white humanoid robot in a T-pose: standing straight, arms out to the sides, legs slightly apart. Smooth glossy white shell, soft grey joints, rounded head with a simple face, full body, plain background. Call the project Robot buddy.
positive.expected_behavior: A 3D card shows progress, then four draft variants, V1 to V4. ChatGPT then suggests next steps. No other paid step starts on its own.

positive.description: Retexture a finished model. Needs a refined (remeshed) Robot buddy in the library, for example after asking to remesh V1 with the defaults. Chat 2.
positive.prompt: Retexture Robot buddy as an ancient stone statue: weathered grey granite with cracks, green moss growing in the joints, and faint glowing blue runes on the chest and visor.
positive.expected_behavior: A 3D card with the stone statue texture. The shape and the source model are kept. Access is not checked again.

positive.description: Browse the library. Should show existing work without spending credits. Chat 3.
positive.prompt: @Flow Studio Show me my recent projects
positive.expected_behavior: A My Library card with the most recently used projects (up to 10) and their previews. ChatGPT replies briefly and does not list the projects. No credits spent.

positive.description: Download a model from the library card. Chat 3, after case 4.
positive.prompt: In the My Library card, open a textured Robot buddy model and choose Download > 3MF.
positive.tools_triggered: None (the download happens from the card, no tool call)
positive.expected_behavior: The Download menu offers OBJ, STL, GLB and 3MF, and the 3MF file downloads. No credits spent.

negative.description: Off-topic question unrelated to Flow Studio. The app should not trigger.
negative.prompt: What’s the weather in Seattle today?

negative.description: How-to for other 3D software. The app should not generate anything; the assistant answers normally.
negative.prompt: How do I add a subdivision surface modifier in Blender?

negative.description: Theory question close to the domain. The app should not trigger or spend credits; the assistant answers from general knowledge.
negative.prompt: Explain the difference between quad and triangle topology.

publication.release_notes:
Version 1.0.0
- Initial release of Autodesk Flow Studio for ChatGPT.
- Create images and 3D models from text or images, edit and re-roll images, remesh and retexture models, download models (GLB, OBJ, STL, 3MF), and browse your Flow Studio library.
